description: A link for someone outside the team (usually a creator the brand hired) to upload photos and videos into this workspace's media library. They sign in to their own Chockstone account (free) and accept the terms before the first upload, so every file names who sent it. The page shows the brief, takes up to max_files files of up to 1 GB each, and lets them add a note when they tap Send; the team gets a notification. Works for `days` days or until revoked (file_request_revoke). Send the url to them yourself; it's shown only once, and never open it yourself. Their files appear in media_list (request_id narrows it to this request) and can go into a post like any other media.

brief.description: What to film or shoot, shown at the top of their page

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

recipient.description: Who it's for: their name, handle or email, like 'Dana (@danamakes)'

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
